settings.title: Settings
settings.recentCount: Recent files on the start screen
settings.nodeDefault: Open the node view when a file is loaded
settings.miniPreview: Show the mini preview in the node view
settings.guide: Settings. These options apply to every file unless marked current file, and are saved automatically.
settings.zipHint: ZIP is useful for sharing and archiving; folder mode writes each image directly into the folder you choose.
settings.custom: Custom… (fill it in on the Export page)
settings.orderHint: With numbers only, the number follows export order (top to bottom on the Combos page).
settings.progressNames: Show file names in export progress
settings.progressNamesHint: When off, only show the image count
settings.confirmBig: Confirm before exporting more than 300 images
settings.confirmBigHint: Avoid accidentally exporting thousands of images
settings.encoderHint: PNG encoding takes about twice as long as compositing. Current: {workers} composite + {encoders} encode threads.
settings.androidMemory: Phones have limited memory; too many encoder threads can fail. Reduce this if export fails.
settings.workerHint: Each composite thread keeps a copy of the layers and uses memory; applied next time a file opens.
settings.quickPreviewHint: Fast clicks show a small image before the sharp one
settings.showGuides: Show the blue guidance at the top of each page
settings.autoRestore: Restore settings automatically when the same file is opened again
settings.deleteSaved: Delete saved groups and rules for {n} files? The open file is not affected; the next import starts fresh.
